name: SB20: RGB-D Crop and Weed Segmentation Dataset
description: The SB20 (Sugar Beet 2020) dataset is a multi-modal RGB-D agricultural benchmark developed by the Agricultural Robotics Lab at the University of Bonn and the PhenoRob Cluster of Excellence, published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters. The dataset comprises 324 synchronized high-resolution RGB and depth image pairs recorded by a field robot operating in commercial German sugar beet fields under challenging direct sunlight, deep shadows, and variable crop stages. The collection provides dense, manually verified pixel-level ground truth masks separating individual sugar beet leaves from invasive weed species and background soil, facilitating research on depth-guided vegetation segmentation and robotic weeding.
